rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice for something happening in the intervening time before a future event.

example.english: Meanwhile, I’ll get the information organized before you come back tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢段時間我會先整理好啲資料，等你聽日返嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 si4 gaan1 ngo5 wui5 sin1 zing2 lei5 hou2 di1 zi1 liu6 dang2 nei5 ting1 jat6 faan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this for two things happening at the same time, especially when they happen in different places.

example.english: Meanwhile, Mum was cooking at home while I was in a meeting at the office.
example.traditional: 同一時間，阿媽喺屋企煮緊飯，我就喺公司開緊會。
example.jyutping: tung4 jat1 si4 gaan1 aa3 maa1 hai2 uk1 kei5 zyu2 gan2 faan6 ngo5 zau6 hai2 gung1 si1 hoi1 gan2 wui6

rows.note: Use this when meanwhile introduces a contrasting aspect or group, like “on the other hand.”

example.english: This plan is relatively cheap; meanwhile, the quality is pretty good too.
example.traditional: 呢個方案比較平，另一方面，質素都唔錯。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 bei2 gaau3 peng4 ling6 jat1 fong1 min6 zat1 sou3 dou1 m4 co3
